records.title: Zero-Cost Lakehouse via GitHub Actions & Pages
records.context: Domestic solar and battery telemetry requires continuous, reliable time-series ingestion and analytical visualization without incurring monthly recurring cloud infrastructure costs (AWS/GCP/Snowflake).
records.decision: Use GitHub Actions for serverless compute and scheduled execution, versioned flat JSON files in the git repository for medallion lakehouse storage, and GitHub Pages for global zero-cost dashboard delivery.
records.consequences: Zero ongoing financial cost and reproducible git data lineage. Git repository size grows with high-frequency telemetry, requiring retention pruning.

records.title: Invariant Verification Gate & Pre-Commit Circuit Breaker
records.context: Upstream inverter cloud APIs are prone to transient counter rollbacks, dropped telemetry variables, and negative register jitter that can corrupt cumulative analytics.
records.decision: Implement a pre-commit quality gate (data_quality.py) enforcing schema conformity, physical domain boundaries, and register monotonicity prior to writing to persistent storage, halting corrupted writes automatically via a circuit breaker.
records.consequences: Guarantees reliable data contracts across all downstream tiers. Prevents corrupted data from entering the lakehouse; requires monitoring to alert on halted syncs.

records.title: External Webhook Scheduling via cron-job.org
records.context: GitHub Actions' internal cron schedule queue experiences unpredictable delays (15 to 45 minutes) during high platform load, leading to irregular telemetry intervals.
records.decision: Replace internal GitHub schedule triggers with an external scheduler (cron-job.org) invoking GitHub's workflow_dispatch REST API at an exact minute schedule (:00 of each hour).
records.consequences: Deterministic on-the-minute pipeline execution, bypassing congested shared runner queues. Introduces an external service dependency.

records.title: Medallion Architecture & Dual-Table Gold Analytical Tier
records.context: Loading multi-year 5-minute interval datasets (>100,000 rows) directly in client web browsers degrades dashboard rendering speed and burns mobile network bandwidth.
records.decision: Decouple Master Silver telemetry from presentation by compiling two distinct Gold tier analytical tables: Table 1 (telemetry_recent_30d.json) for lightweight 5-minute dashboard rendering, and Table 2 (daily_rollups.json) for 5-year aggregated financial and energy ledger analysis.
records.consequences: Ultra-fast dashboard load times under 150ms. Requires an additional aggregation step in the build pipeline (gold_transform.py) and reconciliation checks between Silver and Gold.

records.title: Declarative Data Retention & Decoupled Script Execution
records.context: Hardcoding dataset retention windows directly inside ingestion scripts bloats pipeline code and obscures lifecycle governance contracts.
records.decision: Isolate lifecycle management into a dedicated retention engine (retention_manager.py) driven declaratively by config/data_catalog.json and config/retention_rules.json, executing as a distinct final step in the pipeline.
records.consequences: Single-responsibility scripts (Ingestion -> Gold Transform -> Retention). Retention policies can be updated or audited without touching executable application code.
